policy: Public reference imagery inspected only as noted. Original decorative procedural artwork; no official seals, legends, holder fields or machine-readable codes. No downloaded reference imagery embedded in output.

entities.observations: Visually inspected two illustrated sample cards: pale pink and olive line networks, pale center and burgundy header.
entities.limitations: Medium: sample artwork, not a dated authoritative physical specimen.
entities.interpretation: Rose and sage network; original stepped-plaza relief and canal lines.

entities.observations: Image search returned a pricing poster, not a usable card specimen.
entities.limitations: Low: no card specimen visually inspected. No claimed match to licence artwork.
